title: Create the account and a local profile
description: Sign in with `aws sso login --sso-session dataparade`. Create the Papyrus production account in the DataParade organisation. Add the local profile `dataparade-papyrus-production`. The existing profile `papyrus-production` is another organisation's account and must not be reused.

comments.text: 2026-11-11: account created, access assigned, local profile works.
